heading: Purpose
text:
## Purpose

This artifact catalogues the scaffolding strategies of record for 4CH1: the
official practical-terminology guidance that fixes the vocabulary scaffolds
(SRC-TL-4CH1), the core-practicals guide's spec-coded practical index pattern,
the book's stepwise construction scaffolds for drawing, naming and calculating
(SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1), and the examiner report's calibration of which scaffolds
earn credit (SRC-ER-4CH1). Claims ride only on this artifact's own bounded pack
excerpts. Canonical planes are untouched.

heading: Scope
text:
## Scope

**Covers:** official terminology guidance and its planning scaffold; the
core-practicals guide's spec-coded index pattern; stepwise bond-drawing and
name-decoding scaffolds; arithmetic laid out step by step; extend-by-pattern
scaffolds; answer-construction starters and glossary anchors; examiner
terminology and diagram calibration.

**Out of scope:** practical procedure detail (PRA family) and retrieval devices
(PED-06).

heading: Executive Summary
text:
## Executive Summary

Scaffolding in the evidence of record is explicit and load-bearing. The board
publishes a dedicated practical-terminology guide because definitions vary
between sources, and its planning scaffold starts from variables. The
core-practicals guide indexes every practical against its specification code —
a scaffold pattern that makes each investigation addressable. The book builds
its hardest constructions stepwise: draw every bond first so counts stay
correct, decode a name starting from the longest chain, construct esters the
easier way; arithmetic is laid out subtraction by subtraction; predictions are
scaffolded by extending a known group trend to an unseen element; answer
construction gets ready-made starters and a glossary. The examiner report then
calibrates the scaffolds that matter: terminology precision earns or loses
marks, and diagram neatness is explicitly warned about.
The deepened records extend the scaffolding claim into inference, decoding, and narrative: the observation-to-inference passages that carry the confirmatory test inside the observation itself, the name-decoding scaffold that reads a structure out of the nomenclature code-book, and the crude-oil origin narrative plus size-property ladder that prepare the fractionation schema before any fraction is named.

heading: Evidence / Source Basis
text:
## Evidence / Source Basis

Primary evidence: SRC-TL-4CH1 (practical-terminology guidance pages;
core-practicals guide index pages; Getting Started Guide pages; identity-pinned
scheme of work) and SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1 (stepwise-construction, arithmetic,
pattern-extension, answer-starter and glossary chunks at line+chunk-id
locators). Supplementary: SRC-ER-4CH1 (2019-06 Paper 1C report pages with
session identity preserved via the pack file path); SRC-SPEC-4CH1 appendix
contents page; SRC-SME-NOTES-4CH1 separation-techniques note. Bounded excerpts
with locators preserved; caps enforced by the pack builder.

heading: Limitations / Coverage Gaps
text:
## Limitations / Coverage Gaps

This artifact catalogues the scaffolding strategies visible in its pack's excerpt windows; strategies outside the captured pages/lines are neither enumerated nor denied. The RUN-020 deepening added records only from the held pack surface (zero-append tranche): no windows were appended, so scaffold detail outside the captured surface is neither quoted nor denied. OCR-era quirks of the book parse (ionic superscripts as parsed) are quoted as parsed or paraphrased, never repaired. Examiner-report windows cited by pre-existing records remain the ER plane of record; no new ER claims were added. No examiner sentiment is synthesized from mark schemes. No canonical planes were written.

heading: PED-049
text:
### PED-049 — The official terminology guide fixes the vocabulary scaffold

**Claim:** the board publishes dedicated practical-terminology guidance because
terminology definitions vary between sources, and its planning scaffold begins
from variables.
**Evidence:** the guide's introduction names the problem — "Definitions of terms
can vary between" sources — as why terminology guidance exists (SRC-TL-4CH1,
practical-terminology-in-int-gcse-science.pdf p 3); its planning section
instructs that "When planning an investigation, it is important to consider the
different factors, or variables" (SRC-TL-4CH1,
practical-terminology-in-int-gcse-science.pdf p 4); the guide's contents lay
out the scaffold bands from planning through apparatus to measurements
(SRC-TL-4CH1, practical-terminology-in-int-gcse-science.pdf p 2). Temporal
scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-050
text:
### PED-050 — The core-practicals guide indexes every practical to its specification code

**Claim:** the core-practicals guide's scaffold pattern makes each investigation
addressable by binding it to its spec code in a per-science index.
**Evidence:** the guide opens its science sections by counting each science's
core practicals (nine in biology) (SRC-TL-4CH1,
biology-chemistry-physics-core-practical-guide.pdf p 6) and lists each
investigation bound to its spec code, such as "2.17 - Investigate diffusion and
osmosis using living and non-living systems" (SRC-TL-4CH1,
biology-chemistry-physics-core-practical-guide.pdf p 7). Temporal scope:
CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-051
text:
### PED-051 — Stepwise construction scaffolds for drawing and naming

**Claim:** the book scaffolds its hardest constructions as explicit stepwise
procedures with a checkable first step.
**Evidence:** bond-energy work starts from full structures: "We start by drawing
out the structures showing all the bonds so that you can make sure" the counts
are right (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line
768); alkene naming starts "Start by looking for the code for the longest chain
length" before the double-bond code (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1,
edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 893); ester construction is
scaffolded as the easier route when an alcohol and a carboxylic acid react
(SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 1016).
Temporal scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-052
text:
### PED-052 — Arithmetic scaffolds laid out step by step

**Claim:** titration arithmetic is scaffolded as an explicit subtraction the
learner can replicate, not just a result.
**Evidence:** the titration section works the delivered volume as "volume of
alkali = 23.85-2.10 = 21.75 cm³" before noting alternative titres
(SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 589).
Temporal scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-053
text:
### PED-053 — Extend-by-pattern scaffolds for unseen cases

**Claim:** predictions about unseen chemistry are scaffolded by extending a known
group trend — the pattern does the cognitive work.
**Evidence:** the alkali-metals chapter scaffolds the prediction of francium's
properties by arguing that, moving down a group, "the properties of the elements
change gradually", so the trend extrapolates (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1,
edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 429). Temporal scope: CURRENT —
AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-054
text:
### PED-054 — Answer-construction starters and glossary anchors

**Claim:** extended answers are scaffolded with ready-made opening moves, and a
glossary anchors precise vocabulary.
**Evidence:** the graph-description appendix supplies the starter "You can start
by saying that as the temperature increases, the rate gets faster" before the
harder qualifying work (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1,
edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 1098); the glossary defines
electrolysis vocabulary entries such as cathode and cation in one line each
(SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 1108).
Temporal scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-055
text:
### PED-055 — Examiner calibration of which scaffolds earn credit

**Claim:** the examiner report calibrates scaffold quality: precise terminology
earns credit, its absence costs marks, and diagram neatness is called out.
**Evidence:** the 2019-06 report — the first sitting of the new specification —
warns that when asked to state a term's meaning "no credit will be given for"
loose paraphrase (SRC-ER-4CH1, er.pdf p 18); it notes some dot-and-cross
diagrams were "messy and difficult" to read despite being correct
(SRC-ER-4CH1, er.pdf p 22); and it flags lost marks from "the wrong
terminology" on the final question (SRC-ER-4CH1, er.pdf p 25). Temporal scope:
CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-084
text:
### PED-084 — Observation-to-inference scaffolds carry the test inside the observation

**Claim:** the book scaffolds practical inference by fusing the observation with its confirmatory test and conclusion in one sentence, so the reasoning chain is modelled, not just the fact.
**Evidence:** the magnesium-acid passage runs observation to test to identity — "There is rapid fizzing and a colourless gas is evolved, which pops with a lighted splint (the test for hydrogen)." — and closes with the classification: "This is a displacement reaction. The more reactive magnesium has displaced the less reactive hydrogen." (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 604); the bromine-water passage does the same for the double bond — "You know a reaction has happened because bromine water is orange but the product, called 1,2-dibromoethane, is a colourless liquid." — and generalises into the test: "If you shake an unknown organic compound with bromine water and the orange bromine water is decolourised (the colour changes from orange to colourless), the compound contains a carbon-carbon double bond." (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 967).
Temporal scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-085
text:
### PED-085 — Names are decoded by the same code-book that builds structures

**Claim:** nomenclature is scaffolded in the decoding direction too: an organic name is read as a chain-length code plus position codes, then assembled into a structure by the drawing rules.
**Evidence:** the decode starts at the stem — "Start by looking for the code for the longest chain length." where "'but' shows a four-carbon chain." — and reads each modifier — "There are two methyl groups ('dimethyl') attached to the second and third carbon atoms in the chain ('2,3-')." — before the assembly step: "All you have to do now is to fit all this together into a structure." (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 893); the drawing rule finishes the scaffold: "Then add enough hydrogens so that each carbon atom forms four bonds." (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 893).
Temporal scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.

heading: PED-086
text:
### PED-086 — The origin narrative grounds the fractionation schema

**Claim:** the crude-oil chapter scaffolds its industrial schema with an origin narrative and a size-property ladder, so fractional distillation lands on a prepared mental model rather than a bare diagram.
**Evidence:** the narrative opens the chapter — "Millions of years ago, plants and animals living in the sea died and fell to the bottom." — and fixes the resource framing: "Crude oil is a finite, non-renewable resource." (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 917); the ladder is then stated as the schema's engine — "As the number of carbon atoms in hydrocarbon molecules increases, the physical properties of the compounds change." — instantiated property-first: "Boiling point increases: the larger the molecule, the higher the boiling point." (SRC-BOOK-4CH1-SB1, edexcel_igcse_chemistry_chunks_v3.jsonl line 917).
Temporal scope: CURRENT — AUTHORITATIVE.
